### Added
- **`vm-manager.serviceMonitor.enabled`, `auto` by default like every other monitor of this platform** (giantswarm/giantswarm#36711). The vm-manager component's chart rendered no ServiceMonitor, so `vm_manager_*` and `vm_guest_*` reached no Prometheus. The meta chart resolves `auto` from the same `global.observability.metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled` detection as the rest of the platform and sets `vm-manager.serviceMonitor.labels."observability.giantswarm.io/tenant"` so the scrape routes to the right Mimir instance. `components.vm-manager.versionRange` and the customer BOM's pin move to `0.22.0` (giantswarm/vm-manager#73), the release that carries `serviceMonitor.enabled` / `.labels` — an older release in the prior range rejects the forwarded block, its schema being closed.
